scope: Public web search and publicly readable LinkedIn posts, newsletter editions and indexed activity. No browser UI, social interaction, subscriptions, outreach or contact enrichment.
target: Saudi-market owner or founder before the first core software product launch; supported maximum of two software builders; paid external development demand recorded separately from employee or equity co-founder requests.

findings: Exact first-person Arabic requests expose clearer product and compensation information than broad founder hashtags, but the sampled requests were stale or for existing products and non-cash partnerships.
Current Misk and Antler admission announcements are discoverable in indexed activity. This sample did not expose a current named pre-build entrant with sufficiently complete team evidence.

FounderHQ Weekly has an actual recent idea-validation edition, but its content and visible sampled comments are educational; neither author, readers nor commenters should be assumed to be software buyers.
Antler admission alone is not a pre-build gate: an actual admitted founder explicitly said his product had already launched and acquired users.
Public LinkedIn relative timestamps differ across search snapshots; preserve the displayed label and explicit dates in the body. Do not convert a crawl date into publication date.
Keep search-result-only evidence at lower confidence until the original post can be viewed. Do not manufacture a permalink from a profile excerpt.

reproducible_review_recipe: Search public original posts first; root may use its read-only logged-in Edge tab for exact phrase recovery where public profile opens return 999.
Select current first-person project statements. Mark article, advice, program promotion, supplier, employee vacancy and co-founder request distinctly.
Record the exact post permalink and explicit publication or event dates; leave missing dates null.
Open a named venture's current first-party product evidence and audit whether its first core product is unbuilt.
Record visible software-person minimum separately from a supported maximum. Do not qualify an observed small list as proof of a maximum of two.
Require Saudi scope and buying authority for the actual project, then separately assess cash development intent.
Do not inflate yield with newsletter authors, unidentifiable anecdotal founders, commenters offering services or old admission announcements.
